messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: detected large metering delta for tenant 'cobalt-edge' (dedicated pool). Severity: P2. Paging on-call.

Oliver_oncall: on it. jumping in to triage. who can pull metering logs for the tenant?

Maria_sre: I'm here. Alan, any recent runtime rollouts or metering-forwarder changes in cobalt-edge-prod?

alan_runtime: no deploys in the last 24h from runtime. I see a spike of outbound metering events starting ~02:07 UTC. pulling raw forwarder logs now.

kevin_billing: nightly reconcile flagged an unusual billed total for CobaltEdge — their billed tokens are ~3.8x normal for a short window. Hold on customer comms until we confirm root cause.

alan_runtime: sample from forwarder stream shows repeated events for same request ids with new meter_event ids. snippet:

```
{"req_id":"r_8b3f","tenant":"cobalt-edge","tokens":512,"meter_event_id":"me_9a1"}
{"req_id":"r_8b3f","tenant":"cobalt-edge","tokens":512,"meter_event_id":"me_9a1-retry1"}
```

Looks like the forwarder retried on transient error and produced duplicate emissions; ingestion path currently lacks idempotent dedupe.

tasha_cs: CobaltEdge SRE has started to receive billing alerts and page. They're asking for ETA — they want to know if charges will stop.

Oliver_oncall: immediate plan: (1) stop additional inflated billing by routing the tenant to a safe fallback (metering paused), (2) run offline dedupe reconciliation to compute true tokens and credit, (3) patch forwarder/ingestion for idempotency, (4) re-enable metering after verification.

alan_runtime: executing emergency route change now. command: 

```
redwoodctl route set --tenant "cobalt-edge" --pool "c-edge-fallback" --metering paused --reason "emergency dedupe"
```

alan_runtime: routing switch applied at 02:28:13 UTC. Verified traffic flows to fallback nodes; forwarder emits suppressed for billing.

kevin_billing: starting reconciliation against canonical request logs to compute unique token count. running: 

```
./reconcile_tokens --tenant=cobalt-edge --from=2026-02-18T00:00:00Z --to=2026-02-18T04:00:00Z --out=/tmp/cobalt_recon.csv
```

june_engineer: if duplicates are ~2-4x, this will be material. prepare a provisional credit bucket and CC legal for high-dollar cases.

alan_runtime: dug into forwarder code: edge node restart path re-emits in-flight events without preserving the upstream idempotency key. also there's no ingestion-side dedupe fast path for meter_event_id. patch underway to attach stable idempotency keys and add a lightweight dedupe cache in ingestion. estimating hotfix in ~90m.

Maria_sre: mitigation steps logged in ops playbook. Alan, please shepherd hotfix. Kevin, start draft of customer communication and a finance ticket for manual adjustment.

kevin_billing: first-pass reconciliation: forwarded token total = 12,640,912; unique tokens after dedupe = 6,520,431. duplication factor ~1.94x. preliminary customer delta ~ $9,750. creating finance ticket now (FIN-2026-488).

tasha_cs: telling the customer: "We've placed you on a safe fallback to prevent further duplicate billing events and are reconciling. We will issue a manual credit based on the reconciliation and follow up with detailed breakdown and a postmortem." They asked for expected timing.

Oliver_oncall: approve that message. add exact timestamps for routing pause and verification window.

alan_runtime: hotfix merged to canary at 02:46 UTC. deploying dedupe fast-path to ingestion and adding idempotency header on forwarder.

alan_runtime: canary verification looks good — dedupe cache preventing repeated meter_event_ids within a 10m window. switching tenant to verification mode (forwarding enabled but not billing):

```
redwoodctl meter set --tenant cobalt-edge --mode verification
```

Maria_sre: verification run for ~30m shows forwarded counts align with deduped totals from logs. ready to re-enable live metering after one full hour of verification.

kevin_billing: finance ticket submitted with /tmp/cobalt_recon.csv attached. requesting manual credit and noting customer-facing draft.

june_engineer: also recommend adding alerting for sudden duplication factor >1.5 within 15m window to catch regressions earlier. filing infra alert request.

incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff in 30m.

tasha_cs: customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick action. Keep us posted on credits." :thumbsup:

Maria_sre: handing off to night SRE @james_sre in 25m. James, continue verification and confirm ledger adjustment once finance processes the ticket tomorrow.

james_sre: ack. will monitor verification and re-enable live billing once stable.

Oliver_oncall: post-incident items: RCA owners: Maria_sre (postmortem lead), alan_runtime (runtime fix lead), kevin_billing (billing adj). labels: root_cause=forwarder_reemit_without_idempotency, impact=tenant_billing_inflation, scope=single_tenant_dedicated, mitigation=route_to_fallback+hotfix+manual_credit. postmortem due in 72h.

kevin_billing: final estimate to include in customer note: manual credit ~ $9,750, pending ledger confirmation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated. tenant routed to fallback at 02:28:13 UTC, hotfix deployed 02:46:xx UTC, verification ongoing. thread will be handed off to night on-call.

Oliver_oncall: thanks all — strong cross-team response. Maria will draft the postmortem and CS/billing will finish customer comms.

Maria_sre: created postmortem draft: <https://console.redwood/company/incidents/postmortems/1919800000-cobaltedge-metering.json>

incident-bot: THREAD: handed off and closed for active paging."
